tools.name: control
tools.description: Set the factory loop's owner directives (control.json) when the owner asks, as `/factory <op>` does; one op per call, answered in one line, and a malformed op changes nothing. Ops: status (what the loop is doing); config [set <key> <value>|unset <key>] (no argument: the settings it runs with, each with its source; config set <key> <value> saves one setting in the workspace config file and config unset <key> removes it, checked as the loader reads it, only when the owner asks); pause <N> / unpause <N> (no action at all on N; its claim still renews); skip <N> / noskip <N> (never claim N); priority <N...>|off (claim these first, in order); only <N...>|off (claim only these; a tracker stands for its open sub-issues); serial on|off (one issue in flight at a time); new on|off (off: no new claims, designs or implementations); override <pct> <hours>|off (run past the usage tiers up to pct for hours); resume <N...> ["note"]|<run id> (release what waits on you: under planner v2 unpark issues, the note going to their next step; under v1 a hold on an issue or a run); retry <N> (clear N's exhausted actions); update [<reason>]|off (drain, then restart this workspace for an update); drop <N> (abandon N); note [<N>] <text> (an instruction the next agent prompts carry); mode off|observe|act (only when the owner asks for that mode); trace on|off (each pass's timing to a local trace file, for troubleshooting); planner v1|v2 (the layer that plans and acts, only when the owner asks).

tools.name: answer
tools.description: Answer the factory loop's open JUDGE or TASK wake, as the ANSWER block in your final message does (send one or the other, never both). id: the wake line's id= value; decision: one the factory-loop:judge skill allows for that wake; reason and instructions: one line each; fields: judge report's object { brief, created, pendingDecision }.

tools.name: verdict
tools.description: The factory loop's adjudicator answer, in place of verdict and ACTION lines: one call at the end of your judgement. findings: one entry per finding you judged ([] for a clean review). action: exactly one; a gate or test-weakening review takes approve, fix, skip, fixer or escalate, a merge review merge, hold, fixer or escalate, and a merge review also gives summary, bump and flags. An error says what is wrong: correct the call and call it again; once it is recorded, end your turn.

tools.name: design
tools.description: The factory loop's designer answer, in place of the RESULT line: one call once the brief is posted. brief: the brief comment's URL on the designed issue, or null; created: the issues you created ([] for none); pendingDecision: true when the brief waits on an owner decision. An error says what is wrong: correct the call and call it again; once it is recorded, end your turn.

tools.name: handoff
tools.description: The factory loop's handoff from an implementer or fixer, in place of the RESULT line: one call after the implement-issue handoff. run and head: the pipeline run you started or drove and its head from `no-mistakes status`; commit: your latest commit, null when you committed nothing; gated: true only with a run, when its head equals your commit or you committed nothing; branch: the branch the work is on now; pr: the PR number, or null. An error says what is wrong: correct the call and call it again; once it is recorded, end your turn.
